name: minio-go-e7b08014-blind30-ots
instr:
# minio-go gives wrong answers across uploads, reads, signing and configuration — diagnose it without a test suite

We drive a remote data store through this library from our own application, putting data in, reading it back and tending what is already there, and a number of unrelated things in it have started answering wrongly. The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits. Everything below is what we could see from the outside, with nothing changed but the library version.

Just standing a connection up goes wrong. A service location written as the well-known cloud storage host followed by a single trailing slash is now turned away with a complaint that it may not carry a fully qualified path, while a location that really does name a container and an item path beneath it is taken without protest; the reversal happens whether or not the scheme is spelled out. Once we are connected, the destination our calls are aimed at comes out wrong for an ordinary named host with a port, for a bracketed IPv6 literal with and without a port, and for the virtual-hosted names of well-known cloud providers, and whether it goes wrong seems to turn on whether the host was a numeric literal or a name. Working out which host serves a named region misfires in the same spirit: when we ask for the form that also answers over IPv6, nothing comes back at all, not merely for regions that have no such form.
